storyCards.fact:
Grouplove's "Tongue Tied" reached #42 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Tongue Tied" is a song by American indie rock band Grouplove, featured on their debut studio album Never Trust a Happy Song (2011).

The song peaked at #42 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

Tongue Tied was released in 2011.
